notes: Statements of fires in the Board of Fire Commissioners' reports, fiscal years 1884-1895, read from the page images for the 14 rows whose street number has a page today in the Mission or Eureka Valley. Cause and loss come from the facing page, matched row by row; owners and occupants are left out. A row is described as the building then at the address.

coverage.remaining: Rows in districts renumbered in 1909 (Pacific Heights, Hayes Valley) and in the 1906 burn are not placed.
